best_idea: A restricted district is a list of open-ground area ids plus a list of building ids (neutral buildings left out on purpose), checked against the visitor's own position inside a 40-yard guard radius with owner-based exemptions, and asserted in both directions by a test.
decision_why: Take the membership shape (area ids plus building ids, explicit neutral exclusions, owner rules, coverage radius as data) for Frankendom town districts; drop the WMO numbers and the relocation-only trigger, which is the donor defect.
acceptance: A rival-faction player who walks into any building tagged to the enclave is moved to the gate within 10 s on the server; the same player on the public street is not moved; a server test asserts both directions and a player who stops inside the range is still moved within one tick.
